title: The Coin That Wrote a Warning on Its Edge
hook_text: Scissors bite into a silver coin's rim, a sliver of silver flies at the lens; the clipper grins; the sliver drops into a jar with a clink.

title: Why Razor Refills Are Locked Up Like Jewelry
hook_text: Macro: a $10 razor pack swings on its peg toward the lens; you grab it grinning; the $10 tag stamps on; you cheer WHAT A BARGAIN.

title: These WWII Tanks Were Full of Air
hook_text: A Sherman's barrel swings at the lens at dawn; an enemy observer lowers his binoculars; a GI slaps the hull and it wobbles like jelly; four GIs lift the whole tank over their heads

title: You Wake Up With a Dog's Nose 🐶
hook_text: Your eyes snap open, your nose twitches and coffee and pizza scent ribbons fly at the lens.

title: Why Feeling GREAT Is the Danger When Oxygen Masks Drop
hook_text: When the oxygen masks drop, the most dangerous thing on the plane is how good you feel: Barry giggles under the swinging masks.

title: The Box That Says "You Deserve It" Is the Trap
hook_text: The muddy tournament winner slams his trophy down in front of three sealed caskets; the camera glides onto the gold one as his I DESERVE IT gauge whips to red: the gold box promises him exactly what he deserves.

title: The King Who Banned the Music From Stopping
hook_text: Mid-feast: a servant rolls in a drum taller than himself, four drummers pound, the Shah bellows LOUDER, and his JOY needle drops a notch on every beat.

title: Why the Thames Kept Bringing Parliament's Stink Back
hook_text: A sack stencilled LIME tumbles off a barge and splashes brown water at the lens; the MP holds his nose; Parliament's river front in the heat haze; a sewer arch gushing.
